pad.help.title: Help
pad.help.body:
# What the mod does
Casts buffs **in groups** with one button. It picks the caster, spends the slots and skips everyone who already has the buff. Everything is set up in this menu with the gamepad.
How it works:
1. Pick a group or create your own — a set of buffs for one situation.
2. Add buffs to it. The mod decides who receives them.
3. Tick what should be cast.
4. Cast: {A} on a group in the main menu, or a gesture of the {L5} button.

# Menu button {L5}
This is the menu key from the mod settings; on Steam Deck it is bound to L5 in the Steam layout.
- **Press** — open or close the menu.
- **Hold 0.6 s** — cast "{G1}".
- **Double press** — cast "{G3}".
With the menu closed, the result pops up at the top of the screen for 5 seconds.

# Main menu
{UP}{DOWN}| select a row.
{A}| on a group — cast it; on other rows — open the item.
{X}| cast all shown groups one after another.
{Y}| on a group — open its buffs.
{B}| close the menu.
## Group row
- **buffs N** — ticked buffs in the group.
- **active A/B** — on how many of the wanted targets the buff is present. Yellow — something wore off, green — all in place.
- **next expires** — time left on the shortest one.
- **off N** — buffs of the group without a tick.
## Other rows
- **Buffing in combat** — {A} allows groups during combat. Off by default.
- **Groups** — create, rename, hide, delete.
- **Buff targets** — who receives each buff.
- **Help** — this page.

# Groups
A group is a set of buffs cast with one command. Without its own name a group is called by its **duration** — the main property of a group, used by fill by duration.
## Built-in — cannot be deleted
- "{G1}" — after resting, lasts long.
- "{G2}" — before a dangerous place.
- "{G3}" — right before a boss fight.
A built-in group can be renamed, given another duration and hidden from the main menu. It cannot be deleted: the {L5} gestures rely on it.
## Your own groups
Up to 12, e.g. "Against undead" or "Fire protection". Your own groups can be deleted.
## Groups page
{UP}{DOWN}| select a group.
{A}| open the group's buffs. On "+ New group" — create a group.
{Y}| rename and change the duration.
{X}| hide or show in the main menu. A hidden group is not cast by {X} in the main menu but is set up as usual.
{RB}| own groups only: press twice within 3 seconds to delete. Buffs that were only in it lose their targets; in other groups they stay as they were.
## Name and duration
The name is typed on the on-screen keyboard:
{UP}{DOWN}| and {LEFT}{RIGHT} — select a key.
{A}| type the letter. "Aa" — capitals, "EN/RU" — layout.
{X}| erase a letter.
{LB}{RB}| change the group's duration.
{Y}| done. {B} — cancel.
An empty name means the group is named by its duration. The Steam keyboard (Steam + X) works too.

# Group buffs
Open: {Y} on a group in the main menu or {A} in the group list.
At the top — the group's buffs, each with a tick box. Below, grey — all other buffs of the party, those matching the group's duration first.
Columns: name · duration · whom (self, party, 1 performer) · targets: set of possible.
{UP}{DOWN}| select a buff.
{A}| add the buff to the group or remove it.
{X}| tick or untick.
{Y}| fill by duration — see the next section.
{RIGHT}| open the buff's targets.
{LB}{RB}| neighbouring group.
{B}| back.
## The tick
An unticked buff is off **in this group only**: it stays in the list, keeps its targets and works as before in other groups. Tick it again and it is cast again. Handy for spare buffs without losing their setup.
## Add and remove
- An added buff is ticked and gets targets automatically (see "Who gets the buff").
- If nobody in the current party can receive the buff, it is not added.
- A buff can be in several groups. Removed from one, it stays in the others.
- Removed from its last group, it loses its targets.

# Fill by duration
The main way to fill a group. {Y} in group buffs finds every buff your party can cast and adds those that match the group's duration.
## What exactly happens
- It looks at every buff the mod found in the party: spellbook spells, class abilities, activatable abilities and songs.
- It takes only buffs of the group's duration (table below).
- They are added **unticked** — nothing is cast until you tick what you need with {X}.
- A buff without targets gets them automatically: self, party or one performer. If the buff already has targets (it is in another group), they are kept — targets are shared by all groups of the buff.
- Buffs already in the group are left alone: ticks and targets stay as they were.
- Nothing is removed. Running it again adds only new buffs — handy after a level up or a party change.
- Buffs hidden in the mod and buffs nobody can receive right now are skipped.
## Which buffs go to which group
- "Rounds" — rounds (per level or fixed).
- "Minutes (min/level)" — minutes per level.
- "10 min/level and longer" — 10 minutes per level, hours, days, permanent.
- "Hours and longer" — hours, days, permanent.
- "Toggles" — activatable abilities and songs.
- "Any duration" — no fill, buffs are added by hand with {A}.
The duration is taken from the effect. Without an exact one a long effect counts as hours, a short one as rounds. The duration column shows how the mod read the buff.
## How to use it
1. Open the group's buffs.
2. {Y} — fill. "added N" appears at the bottom.
3. Go through the list with {UP}{DOWN} and tick {X} what should be cast.
4. Remove the rest with {A} — or keep it unticked for later.
5. {RIGHT} on a buff — check who gets it.
> Why unticked: fill takes everything that matches, including what you don't need. You decide — so the group won't waste slots.

# Who gets the buff — automatically
When a buff is added to a group (by hand or by fill), the mod sets its targets by how the buff is cast:
- **self** — the caster can cast it only on himself (e.g. "Shield", "Mirror Image"). Everyone in the party who knows it gets it: each casts it on himself.
- **party** — the buff can be cast on others. Targets are everyone it can reach, pets included. Anyone who knows it and has a slot left casts it.
- **1 performer** — songs and performances. One performer starts it, the first in the party.
Targets belong to the buff, not to the group: a buff in two groups goes to the same characters.
## When to adjust by hand
- A new companion gets no targets by himself. Open "Buff targets" and add him, or press {X} there to recalculate.
- The buff isn't needed by everyone — remove the extra targets in "Buff targets".
- Removing the last target takes the buff out of every group.
- A target given to a buff outside groups puts it into "{G1}".

# Buff targets
Open: the "Buff targets" row in the main menu or {RIGHT} in group buffs.
{LB}{RB}| tab: "Assigned", "All" or one group.
{UP}{DOWN}| select a buff.
{LEFT}{RIGHT}| select a character at the bottom.
{A}| make the character a target or not.
{Y}| whole party: everyone on, or everyone off.
{X}| auto targets: drop manual changes and set targets as on adding (self / party / performer).
{B}| back.
Green — the character gets the buff, yellow — the cursor.

# How casting works
- Only buffs ticked in this group are cast.
- Slots go first to the buffs of the group being cast.
- Targets that already have the buff are skipped.
- A buff in two groups is skipped when the second group is cast: it is already active.
- {X} in the main menu casts groups one after another: the next is planned after the previous one has spent its slots.
- In combat groups don't start unless "Buffing in combat" is on.
## Messages
- **applied X/Y, already active Z** — X of Y attempts succeeded, Z targets already had it.
- **no caster** — the casters are out of slots, rest.
- **not started** — combat with "Buffing in combat" off, or the group is already being cast.

# Example
A sample party: **Fighter**, **Cleric**, **Wizard**, **Bard**, **Rogue**. Spell names are illustrative.
## After resting — "{G1}"
1. {Y} on "{G1}" in the main menu → {Y} fill.
2. Among the unticked additions: "Mage Armor" (hours, party), "Heroism" (10 min, party).
3. {X} on both. "Mage Armor" goes to all five — the Wizard casts it while slots last.
4. The Rogue doesn't need armor: {RIGHT} → {LEFT}{RIGHT} to the Rogue → {A}.
5. From now on, after every rest — hold {L5}.
## Before a dangerous place — "{G2}"
- "Shield of Faith" of the Cleric — party: all five.
- "Shield" of the Wizard — self: only the Wizard.
- "Mirror Image" known by the Wizard and the Bard — self: each casts it on himself.
## Before a boss — "{G3}"
- "Haste" — party, cast by the Wizard or the Bard.
- "Divine Power" — self, the Cleric.
- Fill won't add the song "Inspire Courage" here: its duration is "toggle". Find it in the grey list and press {A} — the Bard performs.
- Double press {L5} right before the fight.
## Own group "Against undead"
1. Groups → "+ New group" → type the name → {LB}{RB} "Any duration" → {Y}.
2. In its buffs: find "Protection from Evil" and "Death Ward" in the grey list → {A}.
3. The group appears in the main menu: {A} on it before the crypt.
## Switch a buff off for a while
No "Heroism" this time: {Y} on "{G1}" → select "Heroism" → {X}. The tick is gone, the targets stay; in other groups it works.

# Where it is stored
Saved at once, per playthrough, in the mod's UserSettings folder. Own groups are visible only in this menu.

setting-verbose-tooltip: Lance chaque buff avec son animation d'incantation complète. Désactivé (par défaut), les buffs sont appliqués instantanément — bien plus rapide pour les grandes routines.
setting-umd-retries-tooltip: Quand lancer depuis un parchemin nécessite un test d'Utilisation d'objets magiques (UMD), relance un test raté jusqu'à ce nombre de fois avant d'ignorer ce parchemin.

pad.help.km:
# Kingmaker
- Scrolls, potions and wands are not used: only spellbooks, class abilities, activatables and songs.
- The cast result is shown in the menu and in the pop-up, not in the combat log.
- A slot is spent even when the spell fails (e.g. armor), as in the game itself.
- The default menu key is F7. On Steam Deck bind F7 to L5 in the Steam layout.
